# Evidence Plan

How every detection moves from SIEM-Ready to Validated: the lab machine, the offensive step that produces the attack, the logs to export and how `rasd evidence` binds them to the run. A status changes only when the detection's `evidence.md` is committed; nothing here is estimated.

**Progress:** 0/18 detections Validated (lab evidence) · Operational Score pending.

## 3 · Domain controller

The lab DC with the audit policy `Test-LabReadiness.ps1 -Fix` sets. The events are logged on the DC about the VM, so they bind through the VM's own address.

- Add `-Spn <lab SPN>` and `-UserList <file of lab accounts>` to the lab run.
- On the DC: `.\red\Export-LabTelemetry.ps1 -LogName Security -EventId 4768,4769,4771,4776,4625 -Since '<start>' -OutFile dc-export.jsonl`

| [T1558.003_kerberoasting_rc4_tgs](../detect/detections/T1558.003_kerberoasting_rc4_tgs/) | [kerberoasting](../red/active_directory/kerberoasting/) · `request_tgs` | client address is the lab host | pending |
| [T1110.003_password_spray_burst](../detect/correlations/T1110.003_password_spray_burst/) (correlation) | [password_spray_simulation](../red/active_directory/password_spray_simulation/) · `spray` | enough base events from the lab host's address in one window | pending |

## 6 · Lab web application

A lab copy of a web application (for example OWASP Juice Shop) on localhost, with its access log in combined format.

## Not reachable by an offensive step yet

No red step names these detections, so no lab run can produce their evidence until one does.

| Detection | What it needs |
|---|---|
| [T1558.003_kerberoasting_volume](../detect/correlations/T1558.003_kerberoasting_volume/) | a burst that reaches its threshold (>= 5 distinct ServiceName per IpAddress in 10m windows) from the lab host |

## Turn the run into evidence

```bash
rasd doctor red/results/lab-<timestamp>/lab-export.jsonl
rasd evidence --run red/results/lab-<timestamp>.zip dc-export.jsonl target-export.jsonl siem-alerts.csv
rasd build
```

`--run` refuses a zip that differs from the `.sha256` beside it and any file that differs from the run's manifest before it reads anything. Linux and web runs write their own `emulation-results.json`; run `rasd evidence --run` once per run folder with its exports. Commit only the `evidence.md` files; the raw exports stay with you. Details: [OPERATIONAL_VALIDATION](OPERATIONAL_VALIDATION.md) · [lab kit](../red/lab/README.md).
